NAME:
   rancher access - Which clusters a subject can reach, which projects it can see into, and what it can do, as the server answers (never inferred from bindings)

USAGE:
   rancher access [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   can:       Ask the cluster's authorizer whether a subject can perform a verb on a resource
   clusters:  List the clusters Rancher lets a subject into, and the bindings that grant it
   explain:   Explain the cluster's authorizer's decision for a subject, a verb, and a resource
   list:      List the rules a subject holds in a namespace, as the cluster's authorizer reports them
   projects:  List the projects a subject can see into, and the Rancher memberships behind them
   who-can:   List the subjects the cluster's authorizer allows to perform a verb on a resource

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --project string            the project, by id or display name, on the cluster given by --cluster (only commands that take --project accept it)
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
